observed_behavior: Under a deliberately seeded local UI mutation, checkout displayed 7900 payable cents and 2000 discount cents for the 9900-cent basket, while the authoritative Oracle recorded 9900 payable cents and zero discount. The regression failed on both independent runs.
hypothesis: The deterministic UI regression detects a client-rendered amount that diverges from the authoritative quote ledger.

steps: Reset a fresh local E1 run with the e1-threshold seed.
Select the E1-99 synthetic SKU and compare visible payable/discount with the same run and quote in the read-only Oracle.
Repeat in a new browser run with a new run_id.
Remove the temporary UI mutation and rerun the same regression; it passes.

human_review.notes: This reproduced finding describes a deliberately seeded and removed local UI mutation. It is a sensitivity proof, not a production defect; no AI Agent blind evaluation or human defect confirmation was performed.
